sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a pop of color to your ethnic ensemble with this exquisite gold-toned nath, featuring a vibrant mix of ruby, emerald, and white stones. This high-fashion piece is a perfect statement for festivities. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely after use.
